message.content:
I’m not able to browse the web, so I can’t pull up a real‑time list of the newest releases. However, you can quickly find the latest movies by checking a few reliable sources:

| Source | How to Use |
|--------|------------|
| **IMDb (Internet Movie Database)** | Go to the “Movies” section and filter by “Release Date” → “Upcoming.” |
| **Rotten Tomatoes** | Click “Now Playing” or “Upcoming Movies” on the homepage. |
| **Letterboxd** | Browse the “Upcoming” tab or search for “New Releases.” |
| **FilmAffinity** | Look under “Upcoming” or “New Releases.” |
| **Google Search** | Type “latest movies 2026” or “new releases this week” and check the “Movies” card that appears. |
| **Movie Apps** | Apps like Flixster, Fandango, or the official app for your local theater chain often have a “Now Showing” or “Upcoming” section. |

If you’re looking for something specific—like a particular genre, director, or actor—most of these sites let you filter or search by those criteria. Happy movie hunting!
